description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber BDD tests related to loan item processing, specifically handling errors during read, process, and write operations in the LoanItemListener context. It uses Mockito to mock dependencies and verify behavior during tests.

classes.name: LoanItemListenerStepDefinitions
